tagline.en: NAVER LABS Europe's DUSt3R — feed-forward 3D reconstruction from a few images, no camera calibration required.
tagline.zh: NAVER LABS Europe 的 DUSt3R——从少量图像前馈式重建 3D,无需相机标定。

en: DUSt3R, from NAVER LABS Europe, made multi-view 3D reconstruction dramatically simpler. From just a couple of images it predicts dense 3D geometry in a single feed-forward pass — without needing known camera intrinsics or poses up front.

Instead of the traditional multi-stage structure-from-motion pipeline, it directly regresses point maps that align the views into a shared 3D space, from which geometry, depth and camera information can be recovered. This made it a widely-used foundation for 3D vision.

In WorldFoundry, DUSt3R is vendored as a 3D base model and exposed through the shared geometry-prior pipeline, so downstream 3D and 4D stages can draw on its reconstruction. Note the upstream weights carry a CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0 (non-commercial) license.
zh: DUSt3R 来自 NAVER LABS Europe,它让多视图 3D 重建变得极为简单。仅凭两三张图像,它就能在一次前馈推理中预测出稠密的 3D 几何——无需事先知道相机内参或位姿。
它不走传统的多阶段 structure-from-motion 流程,而是直接回归 point map,将各视角对齐到统一的 3D 空间,并由此恢复几何、深度和相机信息。这使它成为被广泛使用的 3D 视觉基础方法。
在 WorldFoundry 中,DUSt3R 作为 3D 基础模型内置,并通过共享的 geometry-prior pipeline 对外提供,供下游 3D、4D 环节使用其重建结果。注意其上游权重采用 CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0(非商用)许可。

whenToUse.en: Reach for DUSt3R when you need quick 3D reconstruction or geometry from a small set of uncalibrated images, without setting up a full structure-from-motion pipeline.
whenToUse.zh: 当你需要从少量、未标定的图像快速得到 3D 重建或几何,而不想搭建完整的 structure-from-motion 流程时,选择 DUSt3R。

notFor.en: The upstream weights are non-commercial (CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0), so review the license before commercial use. In WorldFoundry it's a base model surfaced as a prior, not a standalone end-to-end app.
notFor.zh: 其上游权重为非商用(CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0),商用前请审阅许可。在 WorldFoundry 中,它是以先验形式呈现的基础模型,而非独立的端到端应用。
